items.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
items.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

items.title: Binance arranges $6.34 billion to cover losses from record crypto hack
items.summary: Binance said it reserved its own funds to cover the $6.3 billion hack, including freezes of roughly $3 billion in stolen assets.

items.title: Here's how big bitcoin traders responded after the Binance hack hit
Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
items.summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

items.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

items.title: O saque de Bitcoin do hacker da Binance supera a tesouraria corporativa da Coinbase
items.summary: Os invasores detinham 18.270 BTC no início da sexta-feira, superando as participações corporativas divulgadas da Coinbase, e uma reserva de Ether superior a…

items.title: RUNE da THORChain sobe 13% após hack recorde de US$ 6,3 bilhões da Binance
items.summary: Hackers norte-coreanos já usaram a THORChain para movimentar fundos roubados da Bybit e da Bitget, levando a pedidos para que o protocolo interviesse.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin falls to $77,000 as Binance exploit combines with tech woes
items.summary: The $6.3 billion Binance hack added to crypto jitters, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over AI spending pushed the Nasdaq down more than 2%.
